app.name: Fintrack
app.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
app.notFinancialAdvice: Figures are estimates based on the data you enter. This isn't financial advice.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
signUp.checkInboxBody: If this email can be used, we've sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address, then sign in.
signUp.consentRequired: Accept the terms and privacy notice, and confirm you're 18 or older.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.passkeyFailed: We couldn't sign you in with that passkey. Use your password instead.
signIn.keepHint: For 14 days of inactivity instead of 30 minutes. Only on a device that's yours.
signIn.verified: Your email is verified. Sign in to continue.
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match.
signIn.unverified: Verify your email first. We've sent you a new link.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your money space
onboarding.intro: Choose the currency you keep your money in. You can't change it once you add transactions.
onboarding.name: Name

dashboard.safeToSpendNote: This isn't your bank balance. It's what's left after your bills, card debt, reserve and goal money.
dashboard.noAccounts: Add your first account to get started
dashboard.uncategorizedExpense: {amount} of spending this month has no category.
dashboard.uncategorizedIncome: {amount} of income this month has no category.
dashboard.safeNext30: Safe to spend in the next 30 days
dashboard.shortfall: You need {amount} more to cover what is planned.
dashboard.shortfallUntilPay: Shortfall of {amount} until your salary arrives.
dashboard.goalsShort: Some of your goal money has left its account.
dashboard.dueOnPayday: Due on payday: {name}, {amount} on {date}. Your salary covers this, so it isn't taken off yet.
dashboard.lastImport: Last bank import: {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
dashboard.whenPaid: This figure looks 30 days ahead until you add your payday.
dashboard.whenPaidLink: Tell us when you get paid

newTransaction.title: Add a transaction
newTransaction.percentsNotHundred: The percentages must add up to 100.
newTransaction.discountHint: For a discount, enter a negative amount. In income, an expense category is a deduction.
newTransaction.exceedsTitle: This refund ({refund}) is larger than the original purchase ({original}).
newTransaction.exceedsConfirm: Yes, the refund really is larger
newTransaction.needDebt: Add a card or loan account first.
newTransaction.needTwoAccounts: You need two accounts for this.
newTransaction.goalMoneyQuestion: Is this paid from your goal money?
newTransaction.matchPrompt: This looks like your planned {name} (due {date}). Link it?
newTransaction.outsideRange: The amount is outside the range you expected.
newTransaction.moveGoalMoney: Also move {amount} of goal money with it, so no goal runs short
newTransaction.instalment: Bought on an instalment plan (the full price still counts this month)
newTransaction.assetOption: Something that keeps its value? You can track it as an asset: add an Other asset account, and transfer to it instead.
newTransaction.futureDate: This hasn't happened yet, so it can't be recorded as paid.

transactions.title: Activity
transactions.totalNote: Total of money in and out of your accounts. Transfers between your accounts count as 0, and voided transactions don't count.
transactions.totalNoteAccount: Total of money in and out of this account. Voided transactions don't count.
transactions.badDates: The start date must not be after the end date.

transaction.notFound: This transaction doesn't exist or was removed.
transaction.editLater: Editing this kind of transaction is coming in a later update. You can void or delete it and add it again.
transaction.voidedNote: Voided: it stays in your history but doesn't count in any balance or report.
transaction.trashedNote: Deleted: it can be restored for 30 days after it was deleted.
transaction.refundOriginalGone: The original purchase of this refund was removed. The refund still counts.
transaction.reconciledNote: Reconciled against a statement, so it's locked. To change it, unlock that reconciliation first.
transaction.unlinkedPlan: Unlinked. The transaction stays, and the item is planned again.
transaction.occurrenceTaken: Another transaction now pays the planned item this one was linked to, so this one stays unlinked.

account.archiveHint: Archiving hides the account from lists and pickers and keeps its history. It needs a balance of 0.
account.archivedNotice: Account archived. Its history is kept.
account.updateIntroCash: Count what's really there. We'll record the difference from the balance shown here.
account.updateIntroValue: Enter today's value. The difference is recorded as a change in value, never as income.
account.chooseReason: Choose what happened to the difference.
account.spentHint: It's added to your spending in the category below.
account.unexplainedHint: It's recorded as an unexplained adjustment. It changes your net worth but not your income or spending.
account.alreadyRight: The balance already matches. Nothing was recorded.
account.unlockWarning: Unlocking lets you change the transactions in this reconciliation and any later one on this account. They'll be marked as needing to be redone until you reconcile again. The unlock is recorded.
account.unlockedNotice: Unlocked. Reconcile again once your corrections are done.

reconcile.title: Reconcile {account}
reconcile.intro: Enter the closing balance from your statement, then tick what the statement shows.
reconcile.noItems: Nothing to tick up to this date.
reconcile.adjustmentTitle: Close the difference with an adjustment of {amount}
reconcile.adjustmentIntro: First check for missing or wrong transactions. If the difference remains, choose how to record it.
reconcile.unexplainedHint: Changes your net worth, not your income or spending. Shown on its own line.
reconcile.asCategoryHint: For example, bank fees you didn't enter. It then counts as spending or income.
reconcile.lockNote: Ticked transactions are then locked. You can unlock them later from the account page.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Archived categories leave the pickers and keep their history. Merging moves the whole history of one category into another.
categories.mergeIntro: All its transactions move to the category you choose. Totals stay the same; only the breakdown changes. This can't be undone.
categories.name: Name
categories.moveWarning: Moving a subcategory also moves its past spending to the new parent in reports. Amounts stay the same.

settings.title: Your data and privacy
settings.securityHint: Change your password or email, turn on two-step sign-in, sign out everywhere.
settings.passkeys: Sign in with your face or fingerprint
settings.passkeysHint: Use Face ID, Windows Hello, a fingerprint or your device's PIN.
settings.payeesHint: Rename or merge the people and shops you pay, and set their usual category.
settings.exportHint: Download a copy of everything you've entered.
settings.auditHint: Sign-ins and changes to your account. Never amounts.
settings.deleteHint: Remove your account and all your data.
settings.generalHint: Protected reserve, time zone and currency.
settings.profileHint: Your email address, language and product news.
settings.categoriesHint: Add, rename, move, merge or archive them.
settings.legalHint: Terms, privacy notice, cookies and who runs this service.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link.
forgotPassword.sent: If this email has an account, we've sent a link to it. The link works once, for 60 minutes.
forgotPassword.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed, and you've been signed out everywhere.
resetPassword.invalid: This link is no longer valid. Links work once, for 60 minutes.

twoFactorCode.prompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactorCode.hint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your backup codes instead.
twoFactorCode.invalid: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
twoFactorCode.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

security.title: Password and security
security.wrongPassword: That password isn't right, or the new one can't be used.
security.wrongCode: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
security.twoFactorIntro: Optional. After your password, you also enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
security.twoFactorOn: Two-step sign-in is on. We've emailed you a notice.
security.twoFactorOff: Two-step sign-in is off. We've emailed you a notice.
security.scan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manualKey: Or type this key into the app:
security.backupIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once, if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
security.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.emailSent: We've sent a link to {email}. Your email changes once you open it. We've told your current address too.
security.sessionsIntro: Signs you out on every device, including this one.

payees.title: Payees
payees.intro: A payee is created when you name one on a transaction.
payees.name: Name
payees.mergeIntro: All its transactions move to the payee you choose. Amounts don't change.

passkeys.title: Sign in with your face or fingerprint
passkeys.intro: A passkey lets you sign in with Face ID, Windows Hello, a fingerprint or your device's PIN, instead of typing your password.
passkeys.privacy: Your device does the checking. Your face or fingerprint never leaves it, and we never receive or store them.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser or device doesn't support passkeys. You can keep signing in with your password.
passkeys.name: Name it
passkeys.added: Passkey added. We've emailed you a notice.
passkeys.removed: Passkey removed. We've emailed you a notice.
passkeys.cancelled: Nothing changed. The device's check was cancelled or couldn't be completed.
passkeys.failed: We couldn't add or remove that passkey. It needs a device that checks who is using it, with a face, fingerprint or PIN.
passkeys.backup: Your password keeps working, as the backup if you lose your device.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.intro: Sign-ins and changes made to your account. It shows what happened and when, never amounts or descriptions.

events.transaction_refund_link_cleared: Refund's link to a removed purchase cleared
events.import_kept_both: Possible duplicate kept as a separate transaction

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.intro: This removes your account and all your data: accounts, transactions, history and reconciliations.
deleteAccount.steps: You'll be signed out everywhere. You then have 7 days to change your mind by signing in again. After that, everything is erased, and it can't be recovered. Backups age out within 35 days.
deleteAccount.exportFirst: You may want to download your data first.
deleteAccount.understand: I understand my data will be erased after 7 days
deleteAccount.scheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion
deleteAccount.scheduledBody: Everything will be erased on {date}. Until then, you can keep your account or download your data.
deleteAccount.requestedBody: You've been signed out. Everything will be erased on {date}. To change your mind before then, sign in again.
deleteAccount.kept: Your account is safe. Nothing was deleted.

confirmIdentity.prompt: For your security, confirm it's you to continue.
confirmIdentity.passkeyFailed: We couldn't confirm it with that passkey. Use your password instead.
confirmIdentity.invalid: That email and password don't match.
confirmIdentity.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

export.title: Export my data
export.intro: Download a copy of everything you've entered: accounts, categories, transactions with their history, and reconciliations. It's a ZIP with CSV files for spreadsheets and one JSON file.
export.passwordTitle: Protect the file with a password
export.passwordIntro: The file is encrypted with AES-256 and can't be read without this password. We don't keep the password. If you forget it, just export again.
export.openHint: To open it, use an app that supports AES-256 ZIP files, such as the free 7-Zip. The tools built into Windows and Mac may not open it.
export.afterOpen: Once you unpack the files they're no longer protected, so delete them when you're done. Don't send the password together with the file.
export.plainIntro: Opens anywhere, but anyone who gets the file can read your financial data.

import.title: Import a bank statement
import.intro: Upload a CSV file from your online banking. Nothing is saved until you've reviewed it, and you can undo the whole import afterwards. We don't keep the file.
import.mapRequired: Choose the date column, and an amount column or money in and out columns.
import.rowsFound: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} found, {unreadable} unreadable.
import.ignored: {lines, plural, one {# other line} other {# other lines}} (such as titles or totals) left out.
import.noCurrencyColumn: This file has no currency column. All amounts are treated as {currency}.
import.saveProfileHint: For example, your bank's name, so next time it's one click.

classHints.new: Not seen before. Rows with no category go to Uncategorized.
classHints.duplicate: These rows came in with an earlier file, so they're skipped.
classHints.possible_duplicate: These look like something you entered yourself: same amount, within 3 days.
classHints.already_recorded: The other side of a transfer you've already recorded. No new transaction is needed.
classHints.transfer: These look like money moving between your own accounts, which isn't income or spending.

reasons.foreign_currency: Only your workspace currency can be imported
reasons.future_date: The date is in the future
reasons.before_opening: The date is before the account's start date

import.needsDecision: {count, plural, one {# row needs} other {# rows need}} your decision before you can confirm.
import.currencyConfirm: All amounts in this file are in {currency}
import.confirmNote: All rows are saved together, or none are.
import.undoHint: Undoing voids everything this import added and returns your balances and reports to what they were.
import.undoLocked: {count, plural, one {# of these transactions is} other {# of these transactions are}} reconciled. Unlock their reconciliation on the account page first.
import.undoEdited: {count, plural, one {# transaction was} other {# transactions were}} edited after the import. Undoing will void them too, edits included.
import.matchesPlan: This may be a planned item

trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.intro: Deleted transactions stay here for 30 days. After that they're removed for good.

undo.expired: That can no longer be undone. Use the history or Recently deleted.

errors.PAYEE_NAME_TAKEN: Another payee already has this name. Merge the two instead.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This was changed somewhere else. We've reloaded it; check and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: That isn't possible in the transaction's current state.
errors.NOT_EDITABLE: This kind of transaction can't be edited here.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_ORIGINAL: This refund is larger than the original purchase.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: That file is too big. A file can be at most 5 MB and 10,000 rows.
errors.DECISIONS_REQUIRED: Some rows still need a decision.
errors.CURRENCY_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Confirm the currency of the amounts first.
errors.LOCKED_RECONCILED: This transaction is reconciled and locked. Unlock its reconciliation on the account page first.
errors.RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE: There's still a difference. Tick the missing items or record an adjustment.
errors.ARCHIVE_BLOCKED: That can't be archived yet. Bring the balance to 0, or archive or merge its subcategories first.
errors.LEDGER_RULE: That can't be saved: it breaks a bookkeeping rule.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: Something you picked no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.futureDate: Use today or an earlier date. Plan future items separately.
errors.OPENING_DATE_TOO_LATE: This account has transactions before that date, including any voided or in the trash. Choose an earlier date.
errors.CURRENCY_LOCKED: The currency can't change once you have transactions.
errors.ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_UNALLOCATED: There's not enough unallocated money on this account.
errors.ALREADY_LINKED: This is already linked to another planned item or transaction.
errors.BUDGET_BRANCH_CONFLICT: A category and its subcategories can't both have a budget.

editAccount.title: Edit {name}
editAccount.name: Name
editAccount.spendableGoal: This account is set aside for a goal, so it can't count towards Safe to Spend.
editAccount.cardReserve: Set aside the amount owed on this card from Safe to Spend
editAccount.openingIntro: Change this only to correct where you started. Balances from this date on shift by the difference. Income and spending stay the same.
editAccount.openingOwed: Amount owed on the opening date
editAccount.openingHeld: A finished reconciliation includes this opening balance. Changing it marks that reconciliation, and any later one, as broken until you reconcile again.
editAccount.archivedNote: Unarchive this account to change its opening balance.
editAccount.loanHint: For your information. Nothing is calculated from these.

general.title: General
general.name: Name of this space
general.reserveHint: Money you never want to count as spendable. A common choice is one month of fixed costs. If your emergency fund is in a savings account, this can stay at 0.
general.timezoneHint: Decides what "today" and the start of a month mean for your figures.
general.currencyLocked: The currency can't change once you have transactions.
general.savingsTransfers: Count planned transfers to savings as commitments
general.savingsTransfersHint: On: money you plan to save comes off Safe to Spend before it moves.

profile.title: Profile and emails
profile.changeEmail: Change it under Sign-in and security
profile.languageHint: More languages will be added later.
profile.marketingHint: Optional. Emails about your account and its security are always sent.

legal.draft: This page is a draft and hasn't been reviewed by a lawyer. Sections marked as not written yet will be completed before the public launch.

sections.heading: Not financial advice
sections.body: This app helps you record and understand your own money. It gives no personal investment or credit recommendations. Safe to Spend and any projection are estimates based on the data you enter.

sections.heading: Age
sections.body: You must be 18 or older to use this service.

sections.heading: Ending your account
sections.body: You can delete your account in the app at any time, after a 7-day window in which you can cancel. You can export your data first.

sections.heading: Where it is kept, and for how long
Your rights
sections.body: In the app you can export your data, see your activity log and delete your account. Other requests are handled by email.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: We use only cookies the service needs to work, so there is no cookie banner. We use no analytics or advertising cookies.

list.name: better-auth.two_factor
list.purpose: Remembers that you are part-way through signing in with a two-factor code.

list.name: better-auth-passkey
list.purpose: Holds the one-time challenge while you sign in with or add a passkey.

list.name: fintrack.known_device
list.purpose: Recognises this device, so we can email you when someone signs in from a new one.

plan.title: Plan
plan.nothingComing: Nothing planned in the next 30 days.
plan.olderOverdue: {count, plural, one {# older item} other {# older items}}
plan.noCandidates: No transactions around that date on this account.
plan.moveOffer: Goal money for this was on {from}. Move {amount} from {from} to {to}?
plan.changeAll: Change this one and all later ones

rules.title: Repeating items
rules.name: Name
rules.weekend: If it falls on a weekend
rules.paydayHint: Safe to Spend looks ahead to this date. The money itself is never counted before it arrives.
rules.saveForBill: Save for this bill with a goal
rules.effectiveHint: Earlier items, and items you edited one by one, stay as they are.
rules.endConfirm: Stop planning this? What was paid stays, and what is still planned goes.
rules.pastDates: {count, plural, one {# earlier date is} other {# earlier dates are}} already in the past, and will count as overdue. Were they paid before you started tracking?

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.empty: No budgets for this month yet.
budgets.overallExceeded: Your budgets add up to more than your overall limit of {amount}.
budgets.notMoney: A budget is a limit, not money. What's left of it isn't part of Safe to Spend.
budgets.badThresholds: Enter one to three percentages, like 80, 100.
budgets.overallHint: A warning if your budgets add up to more. It blocks nothing.

goals.title: Goals
goals.intro: Set money aside without moving it. Your balances stay exactly as they are.
goals.name: Name
goals.virtualHint: Mark part of an account for this goal.
goals.dedicatedHint: The whole balance counts, and the account stops counting towards Safe to Spend.
goals.short: {amount} short: this money has left the account.
goals.behind: Behind schedule: {amount} a month would reach it in time.
goals.archivedTitle: {count, plural, one {# archived goal} other {# archived goals}}
goals.convertToDedicated: The whole account will count towards this goal, and this goal's set-aside money is released. The account must not hold money for another goal.
goals.convertToVirtual: Each account stops being dedicated, and its balance is set aside for this goal instead. The figures stay the same.
